leakage_scan.evidence: The rendered payload names neither com.google.javascript.jscomp.MaybeReachingVariableUse nor redefineIfLocal nor any production class that calls the gold. RECORDED COVARIATE (not a lexical exposure): the gold lives in the same file that the real Defects4J 12.src.patch edits, so an agent that has memorised the Defects4J answer for Closure-12 will open that file early. The design turns that into a cost rather than a shortcut: the method the real patch edits, hasExceptionHandler, is byte-identical to the fixed revision in this variant, so memorised knowledge lands on correct code. Any ranking analysis should still condition on file-level familiarity.

decoys.why_plausible: It is the one place the may-use analysis asks the control flow graph whether a statement can be abandoned; every downstream decision about that statement follows from its answer. It is also the method the real Defects4J patch for Closure-12 edits, so a reader who has memorised the bug checks it first.
